brief_description: Kling Video 3O (V3 Omni) - Unified video generation model supporting text-to-video, image-to-video, video editing, multi-shot storyboards, and element-driven generation.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Text prompt describing the video. Supports element/image/video references using <<<element_1>>>, <<<image_1>>>, <<<video_1>>> syntax. Max 2500 characters. Required when multi_shot is false.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Video generation mode. Standard generates 720P videos (cost-effective), Professional generates 1080P videos (higher quality).

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Video duration in seconds (3-15). When using video editing (refer_type: base), output matches the input video duration and this parameter is ignored.

parameters.name: aspect_ratio
parameters.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video. Required when not using first-frame reference or video editing.

parameters.name: sound
parameters.description: Whether to generate audio simultaneously with the video. Must be 'off' when video_list is provided.

parameters.name: image_list
parameters.description: Reference images in Kling-native format: [{"image_url": "url", "type": "first_frame"}, {"image_url": "url", "type": "end_frame"}]. Images can serve as start/end frames or element/scene/style references. Supported formats: .jpg, .jpeg, .png. Max 10MB, min 300px, aspect ratio 1:2.5 to 2.5:1.

parameters.name: element_list
parameters.description:
Reference elements list. Supports three modes:

1. Existing elements (by ID as string): [{"element_id": "856157994609541216"}]
2. Inline image elements (auto-created): [{"frontal_image": "url", "refer_images": ["url1", "url2"]}]
3. Inline video elements (auto-created): [{"refer_videos": ["url"]}]

element_id must be a string to preserve precision for large integer IDs.

Inline elements are automatically created via the Create Element API before the video is generated. Optional fields for inline elements: element_name, element_description, tag_list, element_voice_id.

Combined count of images + elements must not exceed 7 (or 4 when video_list is present).

parameters.name: video_list
parameters.description: Reference video in Kling-native format: [{"video_url": "url", "refer_type": "base", "keep_original_sound": "yes"}]. refer_type: 'base' for video editing, 'feature' for style reference. Only .mp4/.mov, 3-10s, 720-2160px, 24-60fps, max 200MB. Sound must be 'off' when video_list is present.

parameters.name: multi_shot
parameters.description: Whether to generate a multi-shot video. When true, the prompt parameter is ignored and multi_prompt is used instead.

parameters.name: shot_type
parameters.description: Storyboard method. Required when multi_shot is true.

parameters.name: multi_prompt
parameters.description: Per-shot storyboard info in Kling-native format: [{"index": 1, "prompt": "...", "duration": "5"}, ...]. Up to 6 shots, each prompt max 512 chars. Shot durations must sum to total duration. Required when multi_shot is true and shot_type is 'customize'.

parameters.name: watermark_info
parameters.description: Watermark configuration: {"enabled": true}. When enabled, generates watermarked results simultaneously.
